note: Auto-download manifest. The engine fetches this (ModelDownloader.fetchManifest), downloads each url into the app's models dir, and verifies sha256. v3 switches the detector to DBNet (m-i-t default, ResNet34 + DB head) replacing comic-text-detector — 1.6-2.5x higher on-device recall on dense/handwritten text. OCR (ocr_int8) and inpaint (mit_aot) are unchanged from v2 (urls still point at the models-v2 release). NCNN roles ship as .param + .bin pairs (both required). Weights are GPL-3.0; see docs/MODELS.md. Urls point at this repo's GitHub release assets.

models.name: dbnet_detect.ncnn.param
models.note: DBNet (m-i-t default detector). resize_aspect to 1024 (pad to 256 multiples); rectangular input avoids ncnn's 832-992 square crash band. fp16 storage (146MB); int8 quant drops all boxes so not used.

models.name: ocr_int8.onnx
models.note: 48px CTC, int8 dynamic quantization (QUInt8) — ~3.6x faster on ARM, 96.7% CTC parity vs fp32, 165MB -> 44MB.

models.name: mit_aot_fixed512.ncnn.param
models.note: AOT-GAN manga inpaint (m-i-t). Fully-convolutional; run at whole-page tile 768 by default.
